procedures.title: Guided ultrasound capture
procedures.description: Reference procedure for the XR flow. It must be curated and approved by a physician.

steps.title: Check the equipment
steps.instruction: Confirm that the probe, gel and tablet are within reach and that the probe has battery.

steps.title: Stabilize your position
steps.instruction: Secure your feet or an anchor so both hands stay free and your body does not float.

steps.title: Apply the gel
steps.instruction: Apply a thin layer of gel over the area marked on the body diagram in your headset.

steps.title: Locate the landmark
steps.instruction: Place the probe on the landmark highlighted in your headset and keep gentle, steady contact.

steps.title: Adjust the image
steps.instruction: Adjust depth and gain until the structure is centered and sharp.

steps.title: Capture the image
steps.instruction: Hold still and capture the image. Take a second capture if the first one moved.

steps.title: Review the image quality
steps.instruction: Compare the image with the quality guide. If it is not clearly visible, mark this step as failed and repeat the capture.
steps.safetyNote: Image quality is part of the evidence. A poor image must not be used for an assessment.
